plugins.name: document-vault
plugins.description: A family document vault run by Claude: drop scans into an inbox (or share from your iPhone) and Claude reads them privacy-masked, names and files them by person and category, combines front and back scans, parks duplicates for review, tracks and archives expired documents, prepares document packs for visa and other applications, and never deletes anything.

skills.name: find-document
skills.description: Finds documents in the family Document Vault and answers questions about them from the catalog - where a file is, when something expires, which documents a person has. Use for "find my passport", "where is the lease", "when does Maria's residence permit expire", "show me all insurance documents" and similar.
skills.description_zh: 从家庭Document Vault目录查找文件、位置、证件到期日与成员持有资料，回答护照、租约或保险等查询。

skills.name: prepare-pack
skills.description: Prepares a document pack for an application (visa, residence permit renewal, citizenship, mortgage, school, new job) by matching a pasted list of required documents to the Document Vault and copying them, numbered in list order, per person. Also archives a finished pack. Use for "I'm applying for a visa, here's the list", "prepare the documents for our renewal", "make a pack for the consulate", "archive the pack".
headings: 2. Match every item to the vault
skills.description_zh: 把申请所需清单与家庭Document Vault匹配，按成员和清单顺序编号复制成签证、居留、学校或工作材料包，也支持归档完成包。

skills.name: process-inbox
skills.description: Files new documents from the Document Vault inbox - reads each one (masked), proposes a name and folder, handles duplicates and front/back scans, and moves them after approval. Also adds a new family member to the vault. Use when the user says "process my inbox", "file my new documents", "I added scans to the vault", "I shared photos from my phone", "add Leo to the vault" or similar.
skills.description_zh: 读取并遮掩家庭文档收件箱资料，建议名称与目录，处理重复和正反面扫描，批准后移动归档，也支持新增家庭成员。

skills.name: set-up-vault
skills.description: Creates a new family Document Vault in an empty folder - people, folder structure, naming rules, catalog and scripts. Use when the user says "set up a document vault", "create my document vault", "organize my family documents from scratch" or has no vault yet. Ends by offering the iPhone Share shortcut.
headings: 1. Ask the few things that shape the vault
skills.description_zh: 在空目录建立家庭Document Vault，配置成员、目录、命名、目录索引与脚本，结束提供iPhone分享快捷方式。

skills.name: vault-check-up
skills.description: Runs a health check of the Document Vault - expiring passports and permits, expired documents to archive, tidy subfolder suggestions, files missing from the catalog, broken names, leftovers in Review. Use when the user asks "check my vault", "what documents are expiring", "archive expired documents", "tidy my vault", "is my vault in order" or wants a periodic review.
skills.description_zh: 检查家庭Document Vault健康，识别到期证件、待归档过期文件、缺失目录记录、错误名称及Review残留，提出整理建议。
